status_definitions.EXACT: Same predicate meaning and effectively identical relationship semantics and direction.
status_definitions.SEMANTIC_EQUIVALENT: Different wording/lexical/grammatical form but identical relationship semantics and direction.
status_definitions.ACCEPTABLE_SEMANTIC_GENERALIZATION: Source predicate represents a valid semantic specialization of the broader canonical VG150 relation without creating a materially misleading evaluation.
status_definitions.AMBIGUOUS_REJECTED: Mapping rejected because it loses essential relational constraints or creates an unacceptable semantic mismatch.
status_definitions.NO_MATCH: No defensible candidate exists in the canonical vocabulary.

strict_4_way_common_vocabulary.criteria: EXACT or SEMANTIC_EQUIVALENT across all 4 datasets.

extended_4_way_common_vocabulary.criteria: EXACT, SEMANTIC_EQUIVALENT, or ACCEPTABLE_SEMANTIC_GENERALIZATION across all 4 datasets.

tri_dataset_common_vocabulary_3way.criteria: Supported by VG150 and at least 2 other datasets.

union_supported_canonical_predicates.criteria: Supported by VG150 and at least 1 other dataset.
